env._comment_beta_unlock: MUST stay 'false' on any profile that can reach the App Store. The EAS 'production' environment sets EXPO_PUBLIC_BETA_UNLOCK_ALL=true for internal testers; a build profile that does not pin it inherits that true, and BETA_UNLOCK_ALL makes useBillingLimits report every user as 'pro' AND skip RevenueCat entirely (src/hooks/useBillingLimits.ts:102). This profile has a submit config with the same ascAppId as 'store', so it is a shippable path — before 2026-07-27 it would have shipped a build where the paywall did not exist.

env._comment_apk: Installable-on-device twin of the 'store' profile. 'store' emits an .aab, which Play needs but adb cannot install, and 'preview' emits an .apk but does NOT pin EXPO_PUBLIC_BETA_UNLOCK_ALL — so it inherits true from the EAS 'production' environment and the paywall silently disappears. Testing the real shipping config on a device needs both: apk output AND the flag pinned false. No autoIncrement, so smoke-testing does not burn Play version codes.

env._comment_unlock: UNLOCKED BUILD — every user reports as 'pro' and RevenueCat is skipped entirely (src/hooks/useBillingLimits.ts). This profile exists so paid screens can be REVIEWED on TestFlight. It is deliberately separate from 'store', which pins the flag false: a build made here must never be promoted to the App Store, because it has no paywall at all.
